title: Verification, terminal matrix, implementation report, and risk ledger
objective: Prove the implemented behavioral contract with full tests, race detection, static checks, cross-builds, PTY/tmux execution, accessibility matrices, and an honest record of untested host-specific surfaces.
requirements: Full repository tests, full race tests, vet, build, formatting, and diff checks pass.
Linux, Windows, and x86 macOS cross-builds pass without a new dependency.
40x12, 80x24, 120x40, CJK, emoji/ZWJ/combining/ambiguous width, and dynamic resize are automated.
macOS PTY and tmux executions pass.
Native/assistive/manual gaps are recorded as Not tested rather than mislabeled as production certification.

acceptance.criterion: All automated repository quality gates pass.
PTY, tmux, narrow terminal, Unicode, and resize behavior are exercised.
Manual platform gaps and shared-worktree risks are explicit.

remaining_risks: Native Linux/Windows interaction, IDE terminal, VoiceOver, and NVDA were not available in this darwin/arm64 session.

The shared branch was committed and pushed by another concurrent workspace session during verification; the final audit patch remains mixed with unrelated user-owned changes and was intentionally not staged or recommitted here.

result.summary: Behavioral alignment is fully automated and green; host-specific production certification gaps are explicitly bounded.
